data.title: Rexel: Statement relating to the total number of shares and voting rights as of August 31, 2026
data.description: Rexel recently released a statement regarding the total shares and voting rights in accordance with Article L.233-8 II of the French Commercial Code and Article 223-16 of the General Rules of the French Autorité des marchés financiers. This disclosure is essential for transparency in the company's operations and governance. The statement contains crucial information about the number of shares outstanding and the corresponding voting rights, ensuring clarity for stakeholders and investors. These figures play a significant role in understanding the ownership structure and decision-making processes within Rexel. This disclosure aligns with regulatory requirements and reinforces trust in the company's reporting practices.

data.title: Absecon Bancorp Declares Third-Quarter Cash Dividend of $1.05 Per Share
data.description: Absecon Bancorp, a bank holding company of First National Bank of Absecon located in Atlantic County, New Jersey, declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $1.05 per share. The dividend will be payable on September 29, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 15, 2026. Trading as ASCN on the OTC market, the announcement was made by the company's Board of Directors on September 4, 2026.

data.title: The Campbell’s Company to Participate in a Fireside Chat at Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference on September 9
data.description: Campbell’s Company (NASDAQ:CPB) shared today that Mick Beekhuizen, President and CEO, along with Todd Cunfer, Executive VP and CFO, will take part in a fireside chat at the Barclays 19th Annual Global Consumer Staples Conference on September 9, 2026, at 2:15 P.M. data.title: Francesca LaBianca Named Chief Operating Officer of Factory
data.description: In a recent announcement, Factory, the prominent player in self-enhancing software development worldwide, revealed that Francesca LaBianca has been appointed as the Chief Operating Officer, marking the company's inaugural executive to undertake this position. LaBianca's association with Factory commenced during her tenure at Mantis Venture Capital, during which she spearheaded the firm's investment in the organization. Transitioning to Factory, LaBianca has collaborated extensively with co-founders Matan Grinberg and Eno Reyes over the last two years as the company has expanded its operations.

data.title: Polyrizon Ltd. Announces Closing of $4.0 Million Registered Direct Offering and Private Placement
data.description: Polyrizon Ltd., based in Raanana, Israel, disclosed the completion of a registered direct offering and private placement on Sept. 4, 2026. As a biotech company focused on intranasal hydrogels, they issued Ordinary Shares and pre-funded warrants to a solitary institutional investor in the direct offering. Additionally, in the private placement, the same investor received pre-funded and investor warrants. The total earnings for Polyrizon Ltd. from both transactions amounted to roughly $4.0 million.

data.title: Orion Corporation: Acquisition of own shares during week 36, 2026
data.description: Share buy-back: Orion Corporation has acquired a total of 100,000 of its own shares on September 4, 2026, at 19:00 EEST. The shares were acquired on the stock exchange as part of the company's buy-back program.
